citation: Hsieh et al. 2025. OMPAL: Bridging Speech and Learning with an Open-Source Mandarin Pronunciation Assessment Corpus for Global Learners. Interspeech 2025, 2415-2419. DOI10.21437/Interspeech.2025-983.
speakerSplitPolicy: SHA256(ompal-v1:speakerId) order; 28learnertrain,8learnercalibration,10frozenlearner test;3native speakers diagnostic references only. Frozen audio not downloaded by default.
annotationPolicy: Non-native detailed raw expert ratings only. All three available ratings must agree per component; one record with fewer raters is ambiguous for that component. Native aggregate reference scores do not imply unanimous expert votes.
expectedPinyinPolicy: Lexical pinyin supplied by separate pinned policy; ambiguity, tone sandhi, neutral tones and multi-character word labels retained with explicit unassessable flags. Model alignment may supply boundaries only, never override expert correctness or lexical policy.
waveformIntegrity: Fixed commit + Git blob SHA1 checked before saving. Actual SHA256 for downloaded WAVs recorded in utterance manifest; unopened frozen-test SHA256 unavailable until explicit preparation.
